userStories.title: Initialize L1 skeleton (8-12 flat domains under root)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Root has 8-12 L1 children. No wrapper nodes. >=10 nodes. NLIV > 0.30.

userStories.title: Expand L2: Home + Books (3-5 each)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Home Goods and Books each have 3-5 L2 children. NLIV > 0.38.

userStories.title: Expand L2: Toys + Sports + Tools (3-5 each)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Toys, Sporting Goods, Tools each have 3-5 L2 children. NLIV > 0.38.

userStories.title: Expand L2: Pet + Cosmetics + Auto (3-5 each)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Pet Products, Cosmetics, Auto Parts each have 3-5 L2 children. NLIV > 0.38.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Electronics (2-3 per L2)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Each Electronics L2 has 2-3 L3 children. NLIV > 0.42.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Clothing (2-3 per L2)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Each Clothing L2 has 2-3 L3 children. NLIV > 0.42.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Home + Books + Toys (2-3 per L2)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Each Home/Books/Toys L2 has 2-3 L3 children. NLIV > 0.42.

userStories.title: Expand L3: Sports + Tools + Pet + Cosmetics + Auto (2-3 per L2)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Each remaining L2 has 2-3 L3 children. NLIV > 0.42.

userStories.title: Refine: Fix all weak edges (NLIV < 0.3)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Zero weak edges. NLIV mean > 0.55. DO NOT add wrapper/grouping nodes.

userStories.title: Refine: MECE audit and structural balance
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: CSC > 0.40. Zero chains. Branching CV < 0.7. Max depth <= 4.

userStories.title: Refine: Final optimization
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Composite > 0.65. NLIV > 0.55. CSC > 0.40. >=150 nodes. Max depth <= 4.
